transactions.description: Placed LW Victor Olofsson and D Max Crotty on injured reserve. Recalled D Ville Heinola from Henderson (AHL).
Placed RW Travis Konecny on injured reserve. Recalled D Oliver Bonk from Lehigh Valley (AHL).
Recalled D Jorian Donovan from Belleville (AHL).
Placed G Igor Shesterkin on long-term injured reserve. Recalled C Gabriel Beaudoin from Hartford (AHL).
Acquired D Jayden Struble from Montreal in exchange for a 20227 second-round pick.
